CustomField.description: Checked automatically by Create Asset Order Event - Mark Order Assets Created when Revenue Cloud reports that the Order's Assets have been created (final Create Asset Order Event). Checking it starts Order - Assets Created - Create Renewal. Platform event-triggered flows can't call subflows, so this field hands off from the event to a record-triggered flow.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Checked automatically once Revenue Cloud has created this Order's Assets.
CustomField.label: Assets Created
